panels.description: Reading guide for this board: which series are live, and what a low/empty panel actually means now that the emitter is wired.

options.content:
This board visualizes the **kbeads embedding + semantic-search pipeline** off metrics defined in `kbeads/internal/metrics/embedding.go` (`gardenio_beads_embed_duration_seconds`, `_embed_errors_total`, `gardenio_beads_embedding_coverage_ratio`, `_embedding_stale_count`, `gardenio_beads_semantic_search_duration_seconds`, `_semantic_search_results_total`).

**The emitter is now wired and the pipeline IS emitting.** As of the 2026-07-17 GRADE crosscheck, 12/13 panels return live data: `ObserveEmbed` fires from `internal/embedding/metered.go`, the search path observes `SemanticSearch*` in `internal/server/{grpc,http}_search.go`, and `SetEmbeddingStatsProvider` is wired in `cmd/kd/serve.go`. The historical emitter gap (ka-0000003559) is closed — a low value below is **real**, not a no-data placeholder.

⚠️ **Coverage is genuinely low — well below the 90% SLO, with hundreds of beads stale.** See the **Coverage** gauge and **Stale** stat above for the current live figures. That is a real SLO breach, not a display artifact — semantic search (`kd search --semantic`) is silently degraded for the large majority of beads without an up-to-date embedding. **Remediation:** drive a resumable backfill on an admin-tokened host with a non-noop server backend:
```
kd embed sync --only-missing        # SQL-filters to missing/stale beads, resumable via text_hash skip
```
Tracking / drill-down: **ka-0000008129** (data-quality follow-up — also linked in the top-right dashboard menu).

_The **Embed error rate** panel is an only-on-error counter (`gardenio_beads_embed_errors_total`, incremented only when a backend call fails); it is baselined with `or vector(0)` so a healthy pipeline plots a flat **0** line ('no backend errors observed'), not a bare 'No data'. A visible non-zero line there is a real backend-error signal — NOT an emitter gap. Use the **Fleet** and **Backend** template variables at the top to slice coverage/latency by fleet and embedding backend._

panels.title: Coverage (SLO ≥ 90%)
panels.description: Fraction of beads with up-to-date embeddings (embedded / total) for the selected fleet(s). SLO band: RED < 50%, YELLOW 50–90%, GREEN ≥ 90%. A live low reading is a real data-quality breach (drain the backlog with `kd embed sync --only-missing`; see ka-0000008129), NOT a no-data placeholder.

defaults.noValue: the beads daemon reported nothing for this selector in the selected range. That is ambiguous on its own — an idle pipeline and a daemon that stopped exporting look identical here — so confirm with `up{component="beads"} == 1` before reading a blank panel as good news.

panels.title: Stale (needs re-embed)
panels.description: Beads whose source text changed since last embedding, for the selected fleet(s). Threshold: yellow ≥ 50, red ≥ 500. A live non-zero here means real re-embed backlog — click through to drain it (`kd embed sync --only-missing`; ka-0000008129). Not a no-data placeholder. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `count(gardenio_beads_embedding_coverage_ratio) > 0` — the sibling gauge the same coverage sweep sets — so a green 0 means the sweep ran and found no backlog.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — the beads daemon is not reporting embedding-coverage gauges for this fleet, so the backlog is unknown rather than 0

panels.title: Embed p95 (5m)
panels.description: 95th-percentile embedding backend call latency for the selected backend(s). Threshold: yellow ≥ 0.5s, red ≥ 2s.

defaults.noValue: the embed pipeline recorded nothing in the selected range. A latency/rate panel cannot render a meaningful 0 here, and an idle pipeline is indistinguishable from a daemon that stopped exporting — confirm with `up{component="beads"} == 1`.

panels.title: Search p95 (5m)
panels.description: 95th-percentile end-to-end semantic search latency (phase=total). Threshold: yellow ≥ 0.5s, red ≥ 2s.

panels.title: Embed latency percentiles by backend
panels.description: p50/p95/p99 of gardenio_beads_embed_duration_seconds over 5m, sliced by the Backend template variable.

defaults.noValue: the embed pipeline recorded nothing in the selected range. A latency/rate panel cannot render a meaningful 0 here, and an idle pipeline is indistinguishable from a daemon that stopped exporting — confirm with `up{component="beads"} == 1`.

panels.title: Search latency by phase (p95, 5m)
panels.description: Splits total search latency into query-embed vs pgvector-scan to identify the bottleneck.

panels.title: Embed error rate (per 5m)
panels.description: gardenio_beads_embed_errors_total by backend/reason, sliced by the Backend template variable. This is an only-on-error counter (incremented in internal/embedding/metered.go only when a backend call fails) — it emits no series until an embed error occurs. The flat 0 is EARNED, not fabricated: it is baselined off `sum by (backend) (rate(gardenio_beads_embed_duration_seconds_count{...}[5m])) * 0`, the per-backend call counter that exists whenever the embed path is wired. So a 0 line means 'this backend is reporting and has not failed'; if kbeads stops exporting the embed family entirely the anchor goes with it and the panel falls through to its noValue rather than painting a confident 0 (ka-0000006531, replaces `or vector(0)`). A visible non-zero line is a real backend-error signal.

defaults.noValue: embed pipeline not reporting — no gardenio_beads_embed_duration_seconds_count samples in window, so the error rate is UNKNOWN (not 0)

panels.title: Embed call rate by backend/op (5m)
panels.description: How busy the embedding pipeline is, split by op (embed vs embed_batch), sliced by the Backend template variable.

defaults.noValue: the embed pipeline recorded nothing in the selected range. A latency/rate panel cannot render a meaningful 0 here, and an idle pipeline is indistinguishable from a daemon that stopped exporting — confirm with `up{component="beads"} == 1`.

panels.title: Coverage ratio by fleet
panels.description: gardenio_beads_embedding_coverage_ratio per fleet over time, sliced by the Fleet template variable. The dashed line marks the 90% SLO — rollout should climb toward it.

defaults.noValue: the beads daemon reported nothing for this selector in the selected range. That is ambiguous on its own — an idle pipeline and a daemon that stopped exporting look identical here — so confirm with `up{component="beads"} == 1` before reading a blank panel as good news.

panels.title: Semantic search result count (p50/p95)
panels.description: Distribution of result counts returned to callers. A sudden drop usually means filters are too strict or embeddings are stale.

title: Kbeads — Embedding Pipeline
description: Beads embedding + semantic-search pipeline: coverage against the 90% SLO, stale (needs re-embed) count, embed and search latency percentiles by backend/phase, error and call rates, and result counts. Open this when semantic search returns thin or stale results.
